items.rationale: This is a necessary preparatory operation for fitting the replacement glazing element, and is included within 'glazing work' per 1.3 and 2.7.2. With the optional Glass Breakage Cover in force, this is indemnified. Reference Case 11 shows t below 19, possibly 0, for a near-identical line.

items.description: Installation of the new glass into the frame
items.rationale: This is part of the glazing work (fitting and sealing the new pane) and is covered under 2.7.2 with the optional Glass Breakage Cover. Reference Case 11 shows t below 41, possibly 0, for this line; use the upper end for a fair market rate.

The fabrication and supply of the replacement pane is the principal insured item under the Glass Breakage Cover (2.7.2). Reference Case 11 shows t below 68, possibly 0, for a similar pane; use the upper end for a fair market rate.

Attendance for indemnified glazing work is covered in full (7.1.12) if only one visit is billed. Reference Case 11 shows t below 20, possibly 0, for a similar line; use the upper end for a fair market rate.
